title: Player Becomes Permanently Stuck in Wall Geometry
explanation: At frame 1285 (t=22.09s), the player entered coordinates (4438.26, 602.42) and was permanently frozen with zero velocity, unable to move despite movement inputs until quitting at frame 1781. Traced to Player.gd:L127-L140 where BugFlags.map2_wall_stuck forcibly overrides velocity to Vector2.ZERO without checking active map context, creating an unrecoverable softlock.
